## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the use case rather than a
specific implementation.

## Proposed solution

What would you like to happen? If it affects OPL syntax, show the input and the
expected OPD.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or alternative approaches you have tried.

## Scope

- [ ] The request fits the documented OPL dialect ([AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)).
- [ ] The request is within the project's roadmap, or explains why it should be
      added to it.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and discussions and this is not a duplicate.
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this if guidance is provided.
